A visitor trait for traversing the AST.

Provided Methods§

fn visit_accessibility<'ast: 'r, 'r>( &mut self, node: &'ast Accessibility, __ast_path: &mut AstNodePath<'r>, )

Visit a node of type Accessibility.

By default, this method calls Accessibility::visit_children_with_ast_path. If you want to recurse, you need to call it manually.
